admission.justification: A future writer/report refactor must not advertise planned identifiers as completed artifacts after a refusal, causing a Curator to certify work that never landed.

applicability: Rendering a knowledge Writer operation whose final state is refused, independent of JSON or text presentation.
conditions: On a refused report, planned outcome count is retained separately while completed records, entries, history rows, carried outcomes, evidence and rulings are cleared before rendering.
A refused result describes no completed file write from that operation; plan-time identifiers or counters never establish a publication.
exclusions: A planned report still describes provisional outcomes and warns that its IDs are not committed identities.
This source-bound record describes the candidate implementation, not a claim that an older serving producer already implements it or a new execution verdict.
statement: A refused Writer report must expose no completed record, entry, history-row or carried outcome and must distinguish its planned count from work written.
